plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.db2_entries: 1..=1161 exact catalog name/FileDataID pairs, alphabetical names and unique IDs

package.manifest: forever-package.json (per-entry partial-section declarations are a later package phase)
package.partial_encrypted_sections_by_entry: For each selected DB2 table, optional deterministic declarations [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}]; no declaration means no skipped sections. The table name is the containing DB2 entry identity.
package.declaration_boundary: This plan/contract phase does not add a package manifest field or claim that the declarations are emitted or verified yet.

limits.db2_sections: Existing bounded DB2 structural ceilings apply; partial-section handling must not enlarge them.

source_policy.db2: Only the exact selected build-70450 catalog entries are in scope. Ordinary decoded files retain the existing full-file validation and output-preservation requirements.
source_policy.partial_sections: The later acquisition/package implementation may skip only explicitly declared encrypted sections for their containing selected DB2 entry. It must preserve the original bounded framing and zero-fill checks; non-zero TACT-declared payload is product_partial_zerofill. No decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.failure_policy: A selected entry that fails source authentication, framing, schema validation, zero-fill validation, or a resource limit remains fatal; it is not silently omitted.

verification.scope: offline package integrity and intrinsic selected-DB2 validation, subject to the not-yet-implemented per-entry declaration gate

acceptance_matrix.expect: admit only build 70450, wowdbdefs-70450-v1, component mask 1, resident storage, disabled decryption, exact DB2-only options and mandatory declared-skip
accept canonical plans selecting one or multiple catalog entries; render and parse roundtrip without client data
reject a missing or misdeclared partial_encrypted_sections field with product_plan_partial_encrypted_sections
reject provided-salsa20-v1 and db2+maps with product_plan_component_scope; reject other builds/catalogs and any non-DB2 option
accept at most 1161 selected catalog entries and reject entry 1162
future source acceptance is per selected DB2 entry, declaration-bound, zero-fill checked, and fail-closed; no decryption
v16 disabled DB2-only and v25 authenticated partial-Map identities, grammars, and contracts remain unchanged

legacy_preservation.v16_contract: forever-product-v16; Build70450Db2OnlyV1; one to 1161 selected DB2 entries, decryption disabled
